fields.title: 📖 Better than they think
fields.body:
🖋️ **Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal** said:

> ***“I ask Allah to make us better than they think of us, and to forgive us what they do not know.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** True **humility** means not taking people’s praise as security. The believer knows his hidden faults and asks Allah for ***forgiveness and sincerity***.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn Mufliḥ, al-Ādāb ash-Sharʿiyyah wa’l-Minaḥ al-Marʿiyyah, Band 3, S. 455.
